name: Nav
intro: Root manages the mobile navigation drawer. Put Trigger, Backdrop, and Positioner inside it, with Content inside Positioner. Use List and Link for destinations or Dropdown parts for submenus.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Pass open to control the mobile drawer and forceAction to prevent automatic dismissal.

props.name: open
props.description: Sets the drawer open state. Root does not forward onOpenChange; omit open for an interactive uncontrolled drawer.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: Backdrop
parts.description: Covers the page behind an open mobile drawer.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: Positioner
parts.description: Positions drawer content on mobile and inline navigation on desktop.
